title: Amplifying Minority Voices: AI-Mediated Devil’s Advocate System for Inclusive Group Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Designing an AI-mediated Devil's Advocate system and providing a task scenario (team leader promotion decision) to demonstrate how anonymously presenting minority dissenting views can reduce conformity, social pressure, and groupthink.

Using an AI intermediary to reformulate direct messages into system-generated insights, intentionally stripping individual identity markers to prevent evaluating ideas based on a participant's power or status within the group.
